supporting_news.title: Indian bonds drift as US debt rout saps oil relief before CPI
supporting_news.summary: On Thursday morning, Indian government bonds remained stable, reflecting a pause after recent volatility. Market sentiment is influenced by declining oil prices and climbing US Treasury yields, with inflation data on the horizon. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to modify its policy rate in light of these figures. Meanwhile, the ongoing Iran conflict could affect oil pricing, as traders prepare for a significant bond auction set for Friday.

supporting_news.title: Nasdaq, S&P 500 futures fall as Nvidia turbulence unsettles AI stocks
supporting_news.summary: Futures tracking the Nasdaq 100 fell significantly after Nvidia shares plummeted due to leadership concerns. Reports about CEO Jensen Huang led to a decline in investor sentiment towards AI-linked stocks. Additionally, the upcoming Producer Price Index data is raising inflation expectations among investors. Concerns over economic impacts and geopolitical risks remain prevalent, with a December rate hike by the Federal Reserve anticipated.

supporting_news.title: India bonds track Treasury weakness ahead of debt supply
supporting_news.summary: Indian government bonds are currently facing losses as traders brace for an influx of debt supply and mounting inflation pressures. The 10-year US Treasury yield is nearing the 5% mark, fueled by predictions of the Federal Reserve's interest rate hikes in December. With India's retail inflation climbing to 6.09%, expectations rise for further rate adjustments by the Reserve Bank of India.
